$comment: Every change applied to legacy catalog data, with evidence. Matching is by a substring of the image filename (stable) — never by position, because the legacy positions were shifted.

kota-stones.evidence: Legacy labels were rotated one position against their images. Descriptive filenames (SHABAD-YELLOW-LEATHER, KOTA-MIRROR-POLISHED, KOTA-HONEY-POLISHED) each carried the label of the previous slot; visual review of the PictureNN images confirmed the same one-step rotation (e.g. the black slab Picture33 now 'Kadpa Black Mirror Polished', the green slab Picture39 now 'Kota Green Leather').

notProducts.Picture29: Lifestyle photo of a limestone-paved courtyard (not a single product). Used as the category card image.

addWithoutImage.name: Kadpa Black Leather
addWithoutImage.reason: Label existed in legacy list (as 'Kadpa Black Leathere') but its photo was never uploaded; the slot showed the courtyard photo. Needs a product photo from the business.

feature-wall.evidence: Labels for the first four slots were rotated one position. Filenames PATALS-PATTERN, LEAF-PATTERN-WALL-ART and FLAWOR-EMBOSSED-WALL each carried the next slot's label; visual review shows Picture23 is the wave-relief wall and Picture18 is a feather/leaf panel installation with no specific legacy label.

nameFixes.$comment: Case-insensitive whole-word regex -> replacement on product names; unambiguous typos only. (Repeated whitespace is collapsed separately.)

imageRecovered.$comment: Legacy URLs that returned HTTP 404 on the staging host; the unedited WordPress original was recovered (see content/raw/image-manifest.json 'recoveredFrom').
